sections.heading: Java Database Connectivity with MySQL
paragraphs: Java database connectivity (JDBC) with MySQL is used to connect Java applications with MySQL databases. It allows developers to perform operations like storing, retrieving, updating, and deleting data using Java programs.
In this chapter, you will learn how to connect a Java application with a MySQL database using JDBC and execute basic database operations.

sections.heading: Required Information to Connect Java with MySQL Database
paragraphs: To connect a Java application with the MySQL database, we need to follow 5 steps.
In this example, we are using MySQL as the database. So, we need to know the following information:

sections.heading: 1. Driver Class
paragraphs: The driver class for the MySQL database is com.mysql.jdbc.Driver.

sections.heading: 2. Connection URL
paragraphs: The connection URL for the MySQL database is jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/sonoo, where jdbc is the API, mysql is the database, localhost is the server name (or IP address), 3306 is the port number, and sonoo is the database name. You can use any database name by replacing sonoo.

sections.heading: 3. Username
paragraphs: The default username for the MySQL database is root.

sections.heading: 4. Password
paragraphs: It is the password given by the user at the time of installing the MySQL database. In this example, we are using root as the password.

sections.heading: MySQL JDBC Driver (mysqlconnector.jar)
paragraphs: To connect a Java application with the MySQL database, mysql-connector-java JAR file is required to be loaded. You can download it from the official website. Here is the link:  MySQL Community Downloads

sections.heading: Ways to Load mysql-connector JAR File
paragraphs: There are two ways to load the JAR file:

• Paste the mysql-connector JAR file in jre/lib/ext folder
• Set classpath

sections.heading: 1. Paste the JAR File in JRE/lib/ext Folder
paragraphs: Download the mysql-connector-java JAR file. Then go to the jre/lib/ext folder and paste the JAR file there. This makes the driver available globally.
